title: BPW-2026-0563
text:
[BUREAU OF STREET LIGHTING]
BPW-2026-0563
CD 8, 9, 14
AMENDED JOINT BUILD AGREEMENT – 110 CORRIDOR FIBER OPTICS INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE the amended Joint Build Agreement for a joint-use fiber optics infrastructure project adjacent to the 110 Corridor with the California Department of Technology;
AUTHORIZE the President or two members of the Board to execute the agreement; and
AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Street Lighting, Executive Director, or designee, to make any technical or accounting updates to the recommendations above to effectuate the intent of the Board of Public Works.
summary: The board is asked to approve an amended joint build agreement with the California Department of Technology for a joint-use fiber optics project adjacent to the 110 Corridor.
